description: Help the user decide what to focus on right now and plan their day. Handles 'what should I focus on today', 'what is my plan today', 'plan my day', 'plan my week', 'what's on my agenda', 'help me prioritize', 'where should I start', 'what's on my plate', 'rank my tasks', 'weekly plan', 'plan tomorrow', 'prepare for the week'. Reads tasks, calendar, and stated objectives, then returns a short ranked list with one-line reasons for each item.
triggerPhrases: I have too much on my plate
